description: This PHP class 'Variances' provides static methods for calculating different statistical variances (VAR, VARA, VARP, VARPA) within the PhpSpreadsheet library. The class extends a base class 'VarianceBase' and includes functions for sample variance, inclusive variance, and population variance, handling various data types including numbers, strings, and booleans.

classes.name: Variances
classes.description: A class providing static methods to calculate various types of variances for statistical analysis within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

methods.name: VAR
methods.description: Calculates sample variance based on provided data values.

methods.name: VARA
methods.description: Calculates sample variance including numbers, text, and logical values.
